meta.name: diagnosing-bugs
meta.description: Diagnosis loop for hard bugs and performance regressions. Use when the user says "diagnose"/"debug this", or reports something broken/throwing/failing/slow.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 诊断并修复代码中的错误和性能问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要定位和修复程序中的疑难杂症
copy.tagline_en: Diagnose and fix bugs and performance regressions in code
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to locate and fix tricky bugs in your code

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会按照六个阶段诊断复杂 bug：先构建一个能快速复现 bug 的测试循环，然后复现并最小化触发条件，再提出多个可验证的假设，接着用探针验证，最后修复并添加回归测试，清理现场并总结。
howto.when: 当你说“诊断”或“调试这个”，或者报告某个东西坏了、报错、失败、变慢时触发。

say.text: 诊断这个登录页面加载慢的问题。
say.note: Claude 会开始构建反馈循环来复现性能问题。

say.text: 调试这个 API 返回 500 错误的 bug。
say.note: Claude 会进入诊断流程，先尝试构建复现循环。

say.text: 帮我诊断一下这个内存泄漏。
say.note: Claude 会按照六个阶段逐步排查。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude follows a six-phase discipline for hard bugs: build a tight feedback loop that reproduces the bug, reproduce and minimize the trigger, generate multiple falsifiable hypotheses, instrument to test them, fix and add a regression test, then cleanup and post-mortem.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you say "diagnose" or "debug this", or report something broken, throwing, failing, or slow.

say_en.note: Claude will start building a feedback loop to reproduce the performance issue.
Claude enters the diagnosis loop, first trying to build a repro.

say_en.text: Help me diagnose this memory leak.
say_en.note: Claude will follow the six-phase process step by step.
